step.doc: Fraction of the way to the one-ring centroid each pass; 0 does nothing, 1 jumps the whole way
step.label: Step

pinBoundary.doc: Hold vertices on a boundary edge still, so the rim does not erode inward
pinBoundary.label: Pin boundary

preserveShape.doc: Project each displacement onto the tangent plane, so the surface slides rather than shrinks
preserveShape.label: Preserve shape

meanQuality.doc: Mean triangle quality after the last run; 1 is equilateral
meanQuality.label: Mean quality

worstQuality.doc: Quality of the worst triangle after the last run
worstQuality.label: Worst quality

report.doc: One line describing the last run

quality.doc: Mean triangle quality of a mesh, in [0,1]

minQuality.doc: Quality of the worst triangle in a mesh
